text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...So it ain't gonna be that easy, huh.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Why are you bowing your head? If anything, 
this just fires me up even more.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
We'll have to start over for today. 
...Still, though—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I'll settle this. No matter what.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
